title: String Slackening Angle in Upper Quadrant

variables.\\theta_{\\text{slack}}: Angle measured from lowest point at which string tension vanishes

assumptions: Tension vanishes at angle theta_slack with non-zero speed
conditions_of_validity: Valid strictly in range pi/2 < theta < pi where cos(theta) < 0
common_misuse: Applying formula when v_bot <= sqrt(2gR) (pendulum oscillation regime)
Assuming speed is zero at slack point
